Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly compared the directors’ birthdates by focusing on the month/day (July 24 vs. May 23) and ignored the years, concluding that 1952-07-24 (Gus Van Sant) was “later” than 1965-05-23 (Massimo Ceccherini).
